outcome: The Financial MIS statement now has a foundation to stand on. The budget workbook's outline is persisted as a per-batch snapshot carrying structure but never money, each leaf keyed by its identity rather than its sheet row, so a reissued workbook maps onto the same lines and a renamed one reports drift instead of silently splitting a statement line. The Mapping Master resolves each SAP triple to exactly one tagged target - a workbook leaf or the reserved unmapped-GL bucket - and the statement reads its own governed projection at leaf/month grain, which is what finally lets Fertilizers, Pesticides and Nursery labour split across Primary, Secondary and Tertiary instead of collapsing onto one line. July reconciles exactly: 81 leaf rows, Actual Rs 1,15,12,712.07, Budget Rs 1,00,50,136.29.
